title: The same Spirit who fell in fire
paragraphs:
The same Spirit who fell in fire
also inspired correction in Corinth.

Pentecost birthed the Church.
Corinth revealed its immaturity.
If it feels real… is that enough?

Does experience define theology —
or does theology test experience?

Not everything powerful is profitable.
And not everything orderly is lifeless.

The Spirit moves.
But He also matures.

🔥 Encounter without foundation burns out.
🌊 Structure without fire dries up.

We don’t choose one.
We discern both.
